select a.instance_id, a.robot_instance_id, a.video_preset_id, b.cruise_name as robot_instance_name, c.cruise_name as video_preset_name, d.device_mete_id, e.custom_id, e.device_id, d.mete_name as device_mete_name, e.custom_name, e.device_name, a.identify_type, a.identify_son_type, a.cruise_type, a.cruise_name, a.warn_threshold, a.warn_level from t_cruise_nonhomologous_point_instance a left join t_cruise_point_instance b on b.instance_id = a.robot_instance_id left join t_cruise_point_instance c on c.instance_id = a.video_preset_id left join t_std_devicemete d on d.device_mete_id = a.device_mete_id left join t_std_device e on d.custom_id = e.custom_id and d.device_id = e.device_id where 1 = 1 and a.instance_id = #{instanceId, jdbcType=BIGINT} and a.robot_instance_id = #{robot_instance_id, jdbcType=BIGINT} and a.video_preset_id = #{videoPresetId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and a.identify_type = #{identifyType, jdbcType=INTEGER} and a.identify_son_type = #{identifySonType, jdbcType=INTEGER} and a.cruise_type = #{cruiseType, jdbcType=INTEGER} and e.device_name like concat('%',#{deviceName, jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%') and d.mete_name like concat('%',#{deviceMeteName, jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%') and a.cruise_name like concat('%',#{cruiseName, jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%') and a.warn_threshold = #{warnThreshold, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and a.warn_level = #{warnLevel, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

and a.warn_time between #{startTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} and #{endTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}
